purpose: Check whether VRAM budget recovery or exact compression can reopen the optimized Q8_0 compute+source path.

vram_budget_findings.gpu: RTX 5090, about 32109 MiB VRAM reported by llama runtime
vram_budget_findings.accepted_memory_breakdown: CUDA0 32109 = 238 free + (17362 self = 17339 model + 18 context + 4 compute) + 14508 unaccounted
interpretation: The only large reclaimable-looking region is unaccounted memory, but it corresponds primarily to the accepted 13568 MiB one-stream gate cache plus allocator/runtime overhead.
Context and compute buffers are tiny; lowering context from 256 to 128 left GPU free essentially unchanged at about 237 MiB.
The accepted path already sets GGML_CUDA_DISABLE_GRAPHS=1, so CUDA graph reserve is not a practical GiB-scale source.
Preserving the accepted gate cache leaves only about 238 MiB, and tiny 256 MiB down-cache probes failed or had zero useful reuse.

closed_recovery_options.name: context/KV reduction
closed_recovery_options.evidence: 2026-07-03 Context-Size VRAM Free Probe: -c 128 still max used/free about 31873/237 MiB

closed_recovery_options.name: independent tiny down/up cache with gate preserved
closed_recovery_options.evidence: 256 MiB down cache allocation fell back to about 34 slots and 0.0% hit rate; corrected 60-slot down path still below SOTA

closed_recovery_options.name: allocator/unaccounted recovery without touching gate
closed_recovery_options.evidence: Repeated accepted-shape runs show free about 236-238 MiB, model about 17362 MiB, unaccounted about 14508-14510 MiB. Existing probes identify this as gate cache dominated.

interpretation: Generic exact compression is about 1.04x on sampled packed expert payloads, far below the 6.9x-9.1x minimum needed for the smallest useful hot subset to fit in the current 238 MiB free VRAM.
Even if such compression existed, decompression overhead would have to fit inside only 61-243 ms zero-overhead slack for top384/top512.
A custom exact compression path is therefore not a near-term implementation candidate without a new model-specific proof.

decision.reason: No known GiB-scale VRAM can be recovered without reducing gate cache, and sampled exact compression is two orders of magnitude short of the ratio needed to fit a useful hot subset in the current free VRAM.

remaining_nonclosed_classes: algorithmic multi-token/speculative path with compatible DeepSeek4 draft/MTP/NextN support
a fundamentally different exact GPU memory layout that shares gate and up/down residency without losing gate hit rate, with a new hard-bound
model/runtime-level change that reduces the fixed 17.3 GiB GPU model footprint without changing correctness
do_not_repeat: generic exact compression of MXFP4 packs
Q8_0 kernel implementation without a new VRAM/source proof
